Texas also saw a substantial change. Trump began his second term with 62% approval and 35% disapproval among white voters, for a net rating of plus 27 points. The latest Civiqs reading showed 44% approval and 47% disapproval.

Missouri’s figures shifted from 61% approval and 36% disapproval to 46% and 47%, respectively.

The changes were also recorded in Alaska, Ohio and Arizona. Civiqs reported net-approval shifts of 22 points in Alaska, 25 points in Ohio and 19 points in Arizona.
